title: Concept: JWT issued without a signature algorithm
description: A JSON Web Token whose header declares the none algorithm in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A token with alg none is unsigned, so a verifier that trusts the header accepts any claims an attacker writes, including an administrator role.
applicability: Deployments that render a JSON Web Token whose header declares the none algorithm into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A token with alg none is unsigned, so a verifier that trusts the header accepts any claims an attacker writes, including an administrator role.
